summary: Iter51 — Auto-Boost (maker) + Admin Feedback Reply + Upgrade Confetti E2E. Backend 16/16 pytest PASS. Frontend: confetti fires only when JWT present, URL is cleaned, ?plus=canceled triggers info toast, auto-boost toggle persists, admin feedback reply modal opens, sends, and closes the ticket end-to-end.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <span>' (and an <option> nested inside a <span>) — surfaced in browser console on every Marketing tab render. Source line: ShopManagerLayout.jsx:100. Not new in iter51 but worth flagging — may indicate a stray select/option inside a span wrapper. Functional impact: none; just console noise.

action_items: [optional] Investigate the hydration warning in ShopManagerLayout.jsx:100 — looks like a <select>/<option> rendered as a child of a <span>. Cosmetic, but easy fix.

[optional spec drift] The review_request says auto-boost-threshold and auto-boost-max-per-run are 'inputs', but the implementation is <select> dropdowns (10/15/20/25/30 orders and 1/3/5/10 listings). Tests should use selectOption rather than fill — confirmed working but worth noting in the QA spec.

[optional] Spec lists 'auto-boost-list' as a separate testid but the component uses 'auto-boost-preview' for the empty/populated container; 'auto-boost-list' is rendered only when next_candidates is non-empty. With a fresh maker (no qualifying orders) the list testid is naturally absent — not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: [good] Confetti useEffect in MakerDashboard.jsx (line 88) correctly gates on `localStorage.getItem('cm_maker_jwt')` BEFORE reading ?plus, so unauthenticated visitors hitting /maker/dashboard?plus=success get redirected to /maker/login with no canvas render. Verified.
[good] URL cleanup via window.history.replaceState preserves the hash (#settings) so the user lands directly on the Subscription panel.
[good] PATCH /maker/auto-boost server-side clamps to (3-100) and (1-10) — verified via 6 boundary tests.

[good] POST /admin/feedback/{id}/reply correctly returns 404 for missing id, 400 for empty subject/message after .strip(), persists replied_at + replied_by + replied_subject, sets resolved=true when auto_resolve, and writes an admin_audit row with kind='feedback_reply'.

[note] Email send is dispatched via BackgroundTasks → send_admin_broadcast. Mailgun DNS may not be verified in this preview env so the actual outbound delivery may 4xx through the fallback chain. The API still returns 200 (correct, per spec), and the DB write + audit row are unaffected — verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — confetti gated on JWT, ?plus=success burst + toast + URL-cleanup verified; ?plus=canceled toast verified; ?plus=success without JWT verified to render NO canvas (redirected to /maker/login); auto-boost toggle on→off persists across reload; threshold (select) + max-per-run (select) + preview render after enable; admin feedback reply opens modal, sends, closes, shows success toast, moves item from OPEN→RESOLVED.

test_credentials: Maker JWT minted via maker_auth.issue_session_jwt('iron-and-oak','iron-and-oak@craftersmarket.org','maker'); Admin JWT via issue_session_jwt('admin','team@craftersmarket.org','admin').
seed_data_creation: Inserted one beta_feedback doc (id=63b0ef54008c11e1, email=TEST_iter51_ui@example.com) for the UI flow + a class-scoped doc (TEST_feedback_reply@example.com) for the pytest flow. Both rows + their admin_audit replies were deleted after the run. Auto-boost prefs on iron-and-oak were reset to defaults (enabled=false, min_orders_30d=10, max_per_run=3).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-boost: threshold + max-per-run inputs are <select> elements, not <input>, so use page.select_option(). They render conditionally — only when enabled=true. With a fresh test maker the next_candidates list is empty (no qualifying 30-day orders), so auto-boost-list testid is absent — that's correct behavior, not a missing element. Admin feedback reply: the inbox lives at the BOTTOM of AdminDashboard → Settings tab (after Run idle-clear / Hard clear all rooms / Danger Zone cards). Reply button only renders for unresolved items in the OPEN tab. After send, item moves to RESOLVED and the OPEN list shows 'No open feedback yet.'
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — features are working as specified.
